[EVENT] User needs help with finding the best travel insurance options for their trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended travel insurance providers include Allianz Travel Insurance, TravelGuard, AXA Travel Insurance, Squaremouth, and World Nomads.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing travel insurance include coverage, destination, duration, age and health, activity level, policy limits, deductible, 24/7 assistance, reviews and ratings, and price.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for travel insurance include reading policy documents carefully, purchasing insurance as soon as the trip is booked, and checking for existing coverage through credit cards or homeowner's insurance.
